segments.sn2.10:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena sūriyo devaputto rāhunā asurindena gahito hoti.
segments.sn2.10:1.3: Atha kho sūriyo devaputto bhagavantaṃ anussaramāno tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi –
segments.sn2.10:3.1: Atha kho bhagavā sūriyaṃ devaputtaṃ ārabbha rāhuṃ asurindaṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi –
segments.sn2.10:4.3: Rāhu sūriyaṃ [suriyaṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] pamuñcassu,
segments.sn2.10:6.1: Atha kho rāhu asurindo sūriyaṃ devaputtaṃ muñcitvā taramānarūpo yena vepacitti asurindo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā saṃviggo lomahaṭṭhajāto ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
segments.sn2.10:6.2: Ekamantaṃ ṭhitaṃ kho rāhuṃ asurindaṃ vepacitti asurindo gāthāya ajjhabhāsi –

lines: Mā, rāhu, gilī caramantalikkheti antalikkhe caraṃ sūriyaṃ, rāhu, mā gilīti vadati.

Rāhussa hi attabhāvo mahā, uccattanena aṭṭhayojanasatādhikāni cattāri yojanasahassāni, bāhantaramassa dvādasayojanasatāni, bahalattena cha yojanasatāni, sīsaṃ nava yojanasataṃ, nalāṭaṃ tiyojanasataṃ, bhamukantaraṃ paṇṇāsayojanaṃ, mukhaṃ dviyojanasataṃ, ghānaṃ tiyojanasataṃ, mukhādhānaṃ tiyojanasatagambhīraṃ hatthatalapādatalāni puthulato dviyojanasatāni.
So candimasūriye virocamāne disvā issāpakato tesaṃ gamanavīthiṃ otaritvā mukhaṃ vivaritvā tiṭṭhati.
Candavimānaṃ sūriyavimānaṃ vā tiyojanasatike mahānarake pakkhittaṃ viya hoti.
Vimāne adhivatthā devatā maraṇabhayatajjitā ekappahāreneva viravanti.
So pana vimānaṃ kadāci hatthena chādeti, kadāci hanukassa heṭṭhā pakkhipati, kadāci jivhāya parimajjati, kadāci avagaṇḍakārakaṃ bhuñjanto viya kapolantare ṭhapeti.
Sace vāressāmīti gaṇḍakaṃ katvā tiṭṭheyya, matthakaṃ tassa bhinditvā nikkhameyya, ākaḍḍhitvā vā naṃ onameyya.
Pajaṃ mamanti candimasūriyā kira dvepi devaputtā mahāsamayasuttakathanadivase sotāpattiphalaṃ pattā.
Tena bhagavā “pajaṃ mama”nti āha, putto mama esoti attho.
Kāmaṃ devaputtavasena paṭhamaṃ devatā uddhaṭā, rāhuno pana payogo tassa vimāneti āha “maṇḍalīti maṇḍalasaṇṭhāno”ti.
Mukhena gahaṇañcettha “gilī”ti adhippetaṃ, na ca ajjhoharaṇanti āha “gilīti vadatī”ti.
Idāni tassa mukhena gahaṇasamatthataṃ dassetuṃ “rāhussa hī”tiādi vuttaṃ.
So hi kenaci abhimukhaṃ atidunnivāro kammaniyāmasiddho.
Padadvayenapi so mahāsarīro mahābalo, candimasūriyānaṃ pana gamanavego tena sabbathāpi dunnivāriyovāti dasseti.
Vimānenāti candaggahe candavimānena, sūriyaggahe sūriyavimānena ubhinnampi vimānena saheva.
Amāvāsiyañhi dve vimānāni yojanamattantaritāni hutvā saheva pavattanti.
Yadi dvepi devaputtā sotāpattiphalaṃ pattā, atha kasmā sūriyasutte eva “pajaṃ mama”nti vuttaṃ, na candasutteti?

“So ca kira na cirasseva tato cavitvā aññattha nibbatto, aññā eva ca devatā tattha vasi, yasmiṃ candaggahe bhagavā taṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi, na tathā sūriyo, aparabhāge pana tatthapi kālena kālaṃ rāhuggaho hotī”ti vadanti.
